title: The Keplerian Traveling Salesperson Problem
summary: We address a fundamental challenge in space mission design and space logistics: planning interplanetary trajectories for missions that must rendezvous with multiple bodies. Such mission occur, for instance, in active debris removal, in-orbit servicing, or asteroid belt exploration. We model these problems as a variant of the Traveling salesperson problem (TSP), which we term the Keplerian TSP (KTSP). Unlike the well-studied TSP, the KTSP accounts for the motion of orbital targets, leading to time-dependent and asymmetric transfer costs that capture key real-world effects in astrodynamics. We…
